about: Music cue sheet for Episode 1, keyed to EDL shot ids (the director's cut/edl*.json). Read by sound/mix.mjs. A cue is placed so that beat `sync.beat` of its score (music/scores.mjs) lands at the start of shot `sync.shot` plus `sync.offset_s`; a cue whose sync shot is not in the cut being mixed is skipped. `end_by` (optional): the cue is faded out (over fade_out_s) so it is silent from the start of that shot plus offset_s. `target_lufs`: the cue alone (integrated) is set to this before the master gain; `duck_db`: dip under every speech window, like the beds. Spotting follows shotlist.json `sound` notes: no music before P-15 ('No music yet'), the theme enters after the narrator's P-15 line, resolves on the title and falls away for the scratch; the hatching cue ends before 1A-15 ('Whisper close on mic; nothing else').

cues.note: Bars 1-2 low string tone from ~71 s (after the narrator's last P-15 line ends at 70.3), the rising horn theme under P-16/P-17 narration (ducked), stops on the dominant at the title cut.
Timpani roll into D major on the title cut; falls away so the egg scratch is alone from T-01 +6 s.
Enters under 1A-05 (fabric, breathing), tightens through the shell breaking (1A-06..1A-12), turns tender at 1A-13 (hushed), silent by the 1A-15 whisper.

1B: quiet tension and awe (D pedal, D-Bb-C colours) for Remi, the climb and the lowered Charcoal; Leaf's light figure (flute, clarinet answer) for Leaf and Abby in the gaps between lines; the dawn theme's head on a soft horn at X3-14/15 ('Morning.'); thin under the pipe, gone as the field goes quiet (X3-16).
Low fifth under the 1B-12 lines, Leaf alert at 1B-13, his figure and a swell to an A major chord as he rises (1B-15), held to the last frame of 1B.

1C-01..1C-06: Leaf's figure fast as he goes first, Charcoal gathers (horns D-Bb-C), tremolo + timpani roll as the air builds and the birds stop (1C-04), full D major tutti with the dawn theme on the massive downbeat (1C-05), a higher second swell (1C-06), gone by the 1C-07 slate.
1C-10 'Wind bed; light theme': high pad + harp, the light theme once on flute, left hanging on F#; gone early in 1C-11 (two wingbeat rhythms only: 'music stops; only wingbeats').

1C-15 'lighter version of the main theme begins' (pad, harp, theme low on clarinet), 1C-17 Leaf's figure, 1C-18 'theme' (dawn head on soft horn), 1C-19 'lighter theme carries the shot' (whole, on flute + violins, resolves to D); faded early in X4-01 (the harbour, still a slate: re-spot when X4 is specced).

X4-20 'Wind; the light theme': the light theme once more, lighter and moving (80 bpm, flute + violins, harp eighths, pad), the dragons following the coast; D add9 on beat 6.25 (4.7 s), faded over the hard cut to Cling (X5-01, cart wheel on stone). Nothing in X4-19 (Remi caught, silence) except (s9) the pad's 0.375 s pre-lap from zero: sync is beat 0.5 = X4-20 (the score is shifted half a beat so the pad can start early; the harp's first pluck is still on the cut).
